connection.lead: Scan the QR code below with the 0KAY Android app to connect. It uses this machine’s LAN IP by default; if you expose Core through FRP or a reverse proxy, change the public host / port / TLS below to an address reachable from outside (Core itself needs no change). Token and PIN may be left empty on a trusted LAN; fill them in for public access so the app can authenticate directly.
